subject: Redwood / FluxPay procurement onboarding — initial call & MAP alignment
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.inference.com>
To: Megan Li <megan@fluxpay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood / FluxPay procurement onboarding — initial call & MAP alignment

Hi Megan —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. I wanted to pull together a short kickoff so we can:
- confirm the procurement/PO path and billing contacts
- align on a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with milestones and owners
- collect onboarding forms we need ahead of activation (PO templates, tax forms, contacts)

Proposed 30-minute windows (PST):
- Tue 11/2, 9:30–10:00am
- Tue 11/2, 2:00–2:30pm
- Wed 11/3, 11:00–11:30am

If none of those work, send a few times that do and we’ll accommodate. Agenda draft (shareable):
1) Introductions & roles (5m)
2) Procurement flow & PO timing (8m)
3) MAP review — milestones, owners, success criteria (10m)
4) Outstanding docs + next steps (7m)

Action items for the call — please either: (a) complete the attached onboarding-form.pdf before the call, or (b) have your procurement/Billing contact on the call. The MAP draft is also linked here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB2cMAPdraft.

Attachments: onboarding-form.pdf (fillable PDF)

Looking forward —

Camila Reyes
Senior GTM Programs, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.inference.com
[Attachment: onboarding-form.pdf (PDF)]

From: Megan Li <megan@fluxpay.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: FluxPay Procurement <procurement@fluxpay.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood / FluxPay procurement onboarding — initial call & MAP alignment

Hi Camila —

Thanks — really appreciate the clear agenda. We can do Tue 11/2 at 2:00pm PST. I’ll invite our procurement lead (Erik), and loop in our legal ops person who handles PO language.

Quick questions before we jump on the call:
1) Can you confirm whether Redwood accepts a standard Net 30 PO and whether a vendor portal onboarding is required?
2) Who will own the PO intake on your side (billing contact)?
3) We have a standard vendor packet (W‑9, bank ACH form) — do you prefer those in advance?

I’ll attach the W‑9 and procurement contact details on my reply.

Best,
Megan
Vendor Operations Manager, FluxPay
megan@fluxpay.com
[Attachment: fluxpay-w9.pdf (PDF)]

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.inference.com>
To: Megan Li <megan@fluxpay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood / FluxPay procurement onboarding — initial call & MAP alignment

Great — Tue 11/2 at 2:00pm PST is confirmed on our calendar. Calendar invite will show a Zoom link.

Answers inline:
1) Net 30 is fine; we can accommodate that. If you need custom billing terms we can document them as part of the MAP and review with Finance.
2) Billing/PO intake on our side will be owned by Lauren Bishop (cc’d). She’ll own invoice reconciliation and PO matching.
3) Yes please — having the W‑9 and ACH details in advance speeds activation. Thank you for attaching the W‑9.

I attached a short MAP-draft.xlsx that maps milestones, owners, and target dates. Key success criteria I want us aligned on during the call:
- PO submitted and accepted by Redwood (target: within 5 business days post-call)
- Onboarding form completed (required to generate the account)
- Technical contact added (for model/test provisioning)

Pre-call ask: can someone on your side fill the onboarding-form.pdf and drop it in the thread or on the Drive link? That helps us avoid a follow-up doc chase.

See you Tue —

Camila Reyes
Senior GTM Programs, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP-draft.xlsx]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.inference.com>, Megan Li <megan@fluxpay.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood / FluxPay procurement onboarding — initial call & MAP alignment

Quick internal note (replying all so Megan has visibility):
Camila — I’ll handle the technical onboarding checklist and make sure the infra team pre-provisions a sandbox once the onboarding form is complete. Lauren — you’ll own billing/PO acceptance and invoice setup (per Camila).

Megan — for the call it’d be helpful if Erik (procurement) can confirm the PO number cadence and whether they require a PO before a trial account is provisioned. If FluxPay requires an executed SOW or amendment before provisioning, flag that now and we’ll bring legal.

Karthik
Head of Platform Integrations, Redwood Inference

From: Megan Li <megan@fluxpay.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood / FluxPay procurement onboarding — initial call & MAP alignment

Thanks team — confirmed for Tue 11/2 2:00pm PST. Erik will join and confirm PO cadence; we can provide the PO after the call but will also bring the procurement packet if that helps speed things up. I uploaded our standard vendor packet to the Drive link and attached the W‑9 to this thread.

Looking forward to the MAP review — we’ll try to have the onboarding-form.pdf completed ahead of the call.

Best,
Megan Li
Vendor Operations Manager, FluxPay
[Attachment: fluxpay-w9.pdf]
